intro: I'm a design leader who builds high-performing teams and design cultures in regulated, high-trust industries — turning complex, technical interactions into experiences people genuinely understand and rely on.

Across fifteen-plus years I've led product design on both the B2C and B2B sides of the customer relationship. Getting as far upstream in the decision-making process as possible to shape the problem, not just validate solutions, is what continues to drive successful outcomes for both customer and business.

focusAreas.heading: Product & experience strategy
focusAreas.body: Setting the strategy and operating model for design functions, and getting customer evidence upstream into business decisions rather than validating them after the fact.

focusAreas.heading: Design systems & design ops
focusAreas.body: Built Nationwide's first multi-platform design system and intelliflo's first production design system — plus the AI-enabled operations that cut concept-to-PRD time by 35%.

focusAreas.heading: Design leadership & team-building
focusAreas.body: Built and led design functions and communities of 90+ designers across financial services, healthcare and mortgage lending.

experience.summary: Leading UX for the UK's leading back-office platform for financial advisers. Built intelliflo's first production design system and integrated AI across design operations for 35% faster concept-to-PRD delivery, with measurable gains in customer satisfaction (+12-point UMUX-lite) and feature adoption (+15% on Wealthlink).

Led the Product Design function through a company-wide shift to a design-led, user-centred culture. Launched a centralised insights hub and introduced UX metrics (UMUX-lite) to measure product impact.
Built and developed a community of 90+ product designers, and defined the Service and Experience Design adoption strategy across Engineering, Product and Marketing.

Led the creation and adoption of Nationwide's first multi-platform design system, and contributed directly to critical member journeys including mortgage applications and a financial wellbeing health check tool.
Oversaw the website and web-application division as a product design specialist, working the full project lifecycle for global brands from client pitch through to design, testing and brand direction.
Designed and built websites for Mattel sub-brands including Barbie and Hot Wheels, translating client briefs into digital solutions for international promotions.
B2B digital and print communications for clients including BT, O2 and RBS.
